name: Odisha
tagline: Where the Sun Meets the Sea

topAttractions.name: Sun Temple of Konark
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most iconic temples in India, built in the 13th century during the reign of King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.

topAttractions.name: Chilka Lake
topAttractions.description: The largest saltwater lake in Asia, known for its migratory birds and dolphin sightings.

topAttractions.name: Puri Beach
topAttractions.description: A popular beach destination and one of the most sacred beaches in India, known for its annual Rath Yatra festival.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February, when the weather is mild and pleasant, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities.
culturalFact: Odisha is home to the ancient Jagannath Temple in Puri, one of the four sacred dhams in Hinduism, and a major pilgrimage site for millions of devotees every year.

hiddenGem.name: Raghurajpur Village
hiddenGem.description: A quaint village famous for its traditional pattachitra paintings, a unique form of Indian folk art.

relatedFestival: Rath Yatra, a grand festival celebrated in Puri, where Lord Jagannath, Lord Balabhadra, and Goddess Subhadra are taken out in a grand procession on chariots.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for Odisha, you might have already visited the Konark Sun Temple or tried the delicious Dahi Bara at a local street food stall!
